authority: Owner: no-retry covers answered content only. Retry no HTTP response or TLS EOF with backoff up to 3 tries, 10 to 60 seconds; Luna at most 2 concurrent; retain all attempts; inconclusive only after retries fail.
policy: At most 3 total attempts; 10s before attempt 2, 30s before attempt 3; no retry of returned model content; effective records overlay retry results while preserving original raw records.
